stories.title: At least 14 missing after Russian drone hit a building in Kyiv region, Zelenskiy says
stories.summary: Ukraine's president said at least 14 people were missing after a Russian drone strike hit a building in the Kyiv region, as Russian missile and drone attacks continued to damage homes with winter setting in.

stories.title: COP31 climate deal in the balance after fractious overtime talks
stories.summary: UN climate talks in Antalya, Türkiye have dragged into a second day of overtime as a draft deal acknowledges warming is on course to exceed 1.5C while avoiding calls to phase down fossil fuels. A final agreement remains up in the air as the summit lurches toward a finish.

stories.title: Russian cargo ship still on fire off Finland after drone attack
stories.summary: The Russia-linked cargo ship Sparta II is still ablaze in the Baltic Sea off Finland, and the Finnish military said Ukraine likely carried out the drone strike. It is the latest sign of the war spilling over into Baltic shipping lanes.

stories.title: Seven bodies recovered, around 50 missing after Indonesian candy factory fire
stories.summary: Rescuers have recovered seven bodies with about 50 workers still unaccounted for after a fire swept through the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia candy factory in Serang, Banten on Saturday. The blaze reportedly started at a cooling unit on the third floor.

stories.title: Trump confirms FBI's national crime database NCIC was targeted in hack
stories.summary: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of the National Crime Information Center, the database police nationwide use for warrants, fugitives and stolen-property checks. Trump acknowledged the hack in a Fox News interview and a law enforcement source confirmed it to ABC News; the scope and culprits remain unclear.

stories.title: South Korea's education minister resigns over AI exam-cheating scandal
stories.summary: Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin stepped down Sunday, taking responsibility after an AI-assisted cheating scandal and last-minute anti-AI-cheating rules threw the run-up to the Suneung, South Korea's high-stakes college entrance exam, into turmoil. President Lee Jae Myung accepted the resignation.

stories.title: OpenRouter drops three AI inference providers after prompt-theft findings
stories.summary: OpenRouter said it off-boarded three AI inference providers and removed 125 endpoints from Zero Data Retention eligibility after Dragos researchers seeded about 2 million canary prompts and found months of prompt theft, including stolen AWS keys and S3 bucket searches. OpenRouter says its own gateway was not breached and affected customers have been notified.

stories.title: Sunday Dawg Chow: Browns idle on bye at 6-4
stories.summary: The Browns enjoy their Week 11 bye sitting at 6-4, with today's roundup catching up on the roster picture — six players on injured reserve and a few candidates to return after the week off — plus what to watch around the AFC North on Sunday.

stories.title: Browns bye week primer: No. 7 seed, healthy roster, Watson question
stories.summary: Cleveland (6-4) enters its Week 11 bye holding the AFC's No. 7 seed with a 61% playoff chance per The Athletic, and returns to three straight home games starting with rookie QB Fernando Mendoza and the Raiders on Sunday night Nov. 29. Safety Ronnie Hickman cleared concussion protocol, while Deshaun Watson extension chatter grows despite a planned post-June 1 release path in 2027.

stories.title: What's next for Ohio State after Nebraska loss ends playoff hopes
stories.summary: Ohio State's 31-28 loss at Nebraska — its fourth of the season — killed the Buckeyes' Big Ten title game and College Football Playoff hopes, even though Indiana and UCLA also lost Saturday and left the door open. All that's left to play for is redemption against Michigan in Columbus at noon Saturday on FOX, a year after the Wolverines' 13-10 upset and the midfield flag-planting melee.

stories.title: 'So far below my level' — Verstappen hits back at Russell after Vegas win
stories.summary: After winning the Las Vegas Grand Prix, Verstappen dismissed George Russell's weekend criticism, saying the Mercedes driver is 'so far below my level' — reigniting a rivalry that burned through a race in which Russell repeatedly overtook him for the lead only for Verstappen to retake it each time.

stories.title: Verstappen claims 75th career win as Mercedes challenge unravels in Vegas
stories.summary: Verstappen took his 75th Grand Prix victory — fourth of 2026 and third in Las Vegas — from pole after Russell crashed trying to pass team-mate Antonelli and Antonelli lost pace on the final lap, handing second and third to McLaren's Norris (+0.639s) and Piastri (up from 17th). The result strengthens Verstappen's hold on second in the drivers' championship over Russell.

stories.title: Verstappen wins exhilarating Las Vegas Grand Prix from Norris and Piastri
stories.summary: Max Verstappen held off a race-long challenge from Mercedes duo George Russell and Kimi Antonelli — both of whom dramatically fell off the podium in the closing laps — to seal his third win on the Vegas Strip from pole, ahead of McLaren's Norris and Piastri. Lewis Hamilton took a 10-second penalty and the Ferraris collided in the late chaos.

stories.title: Columbus weather: Mild conditions coming to an end
stories.summary: Central Ohio gets one last unseasonably warm day — highs in the mid-to-upper 60s, roughly 15 degrees above normal — before a cold front brings light rain Sunday night and a sharp cooldown into the 40s for Thanksgiving week. Forecasters flag a possible wintry mix Friday for post-holiday travel, with 40s expected when Michigan visits Columbus Saturday.

stories.title: Blue Jackets topple Maple Leafs with two goals in final minutes
stories.summary: The Blue Jackets scored twice inside the final five minutes to beat Toronto 4-3 Saturday night, with Zach Werenski netting the go-ahead goal with 3:28 left and Adam Fantilli adding a goal and an assist. The loss stretched the reeling Maple Leafs' winless streak to nine games.

stories.title: OHSAA announces high school football state semifinal pairings
stories.summary: The OHSAA released the state semifinal pairings and sites for the 2026 high school football playoffs after Friday night's regional finals, setting the final-four matchups in each division. Central Ohio programs now know their paths to the state championship games.

stories.title: Crew shock defending champion Inter Miami 3-0 in playoff opener
stories.summary: The Columbus Crew blanked Messi's Inter Miami 3-0 on the road to open their best-of-three MLS playoff series, with Gonzalo Tapia scoring twice and homegrown midfielder Taha Habroune adding the third. The Crew can knock out the defending MLS Cup champions when the series moves to Columbus on Black Friday.
